title: Experimental evals triage — 2027-06-14
content:
Purpose: capture this week's applied-ML research standup and triage decisions focused on quantization experiments, eval failures, and model onboarding knocks. This is a raw working note — decisions and action owners live here until formal PRDs are filed.

Meeting snapshot
Date: 2027-06-14
Attendees: Ethan (owner), Priya, Liu, Ava, Marco, (guest: Sasha from runtime)
Duration: 45m

Summary TL;DR
- Triaged 3 flaky evals — two are instrumentation issues, one is a genuine drop after 6-bit quant on model B.
- Agreed to pause wide rollout of 6-bit flavor for model B until targeted degradation root cause is understood.
- Decided to run a focused A/B eval with prefix-caching enabled for the 6-bit variant (smaller context windows).
- Model onboarding checklist updated with an extra eval stage (stability over 48h with nightly synthetic load).

Notes / Discussion points
1) Eval failures and quick diagnostics
  - EVAL-1123 (semantic-similarity drift): Priya found that the embedding normalization step in the evaluation harness was being run twice; fixed in local branch. Action: Priya to push fix + unit test. Related GH: serving-runtime PR #812.
  - EVAL-1140 (generation hallucination spike on weather prompts): Liu reproduced — only happens with 6-bit quant at 2048 context when KV cache warms cold. Hypothesis: quantization-induced attention precision loss + cache materialization timing. Action: run token-level attention logging on cold-start traces. Owner: Liu.
  - EVAL-1142 (throughput regression under batching at high concurrency): Ava observed scheduler mis-estimates in the micro-batcher for small response lengths. Likely a config/threshold mismatch introduced by recent batching heuristic tweak. Action: Marco to snapshot scheduler metrics and revert heuristic in staging if reproducible.

2) Quantization experiments status
  - Model A (chat-medium): 8-bit dynamic quant profiles look stable; latency down ~18% p50, quality MRR within noise. Scheduled: limited dogfood by product next week.
  - Model B (assistant-large): 6-bit aggressive quant produced notable perplexity jump on multi-step reasoning prompts. We discussed three mitigations: (a) mixed-precision on attention weights, (b) per-channel calibration on top-10 layers, (c) KV-cache prefudge (warming shorter prefixes).
  - Decision: run back-to-back experiments with (a) and (b) in isolated infra pools. If neither recovers, fallback to 7-bit mid-term. Owners: Priya (a), Liu (b).

3) Model onboarding pipeline changes
  - New step added to onboarding checklist: 48-hour synthetic stability test with variable concurrency + prefix-cold starts. Reason: recent regressions surfaced only after sustained noisy load.
  - Onboarding docs: added section on "quant tuning knobs that must be recorded" (bit-width, per-layer calibration seed, activation-clipping settings). Owner: Marco to update confluence page.

4) Observability gaps called out
  - Missing token-level hash in the eval harness that would allow mapping regen probability to specific token positions. Request: tracing hook in runtime that exports per-token log-prob deltas to metrics. Sasha to prototype.
  - Need a compact alert for sudden eval drift (automated) — propose lightweight cron that runs house-eval subset every 3 hours and posts to #applied-ml-evals on Slack. Owner: Ava (script) + SRE for alert routing.

Action items (owner — due)
- Priya: push eval harness normalization fix + unit test (EVAL-1123) — due 2027-06-16
- Liu: run attention-logging traces for EVAL-1140 and produce comparative plots (cold vs warm KV) — due 2027-06-18
- Marco: snapshot scheduler metrics and prepare rollback plan for batching heuristic; update onboarding docs writenote — due 2027-06-17
- Sasha: prototype per-token trace exporter in runtime, initial PoC in feature branch — due 2027-06-21
- Ava: implement 3-hour house-eval cron and Slack notifier, coordinate with SRE for alerting policy — due 2027-06-20

Parking lot / open questions
- If mixed-precision on attention weights fixes the issue, what's the long-term plan for model packaging complexity? Tradeoff: more profile variants vs fewer stable defaults.
- Cost modeling for 7-bit vs 6-bit with mixed-precision needs to be produced for go/no-go with product; finance is waiting for delta-per-token estimates. Marco to ask pricing/finance for quick model.
- Should we expand automated evals to include user-generated failure cases from support repros? Pros: catches regressions earlier. Cons: dataset privacy/labeling overhead.

Quick experiment schedule (next two weeks)
- Week 1 (6/14–6/20): run (a) mixed-precision attention and (b) per-channel calibration experiments, 48-hour stability tests for any candidate that passes smoke tests. Daily small-summaries in #applied-ml-evals.
- Week 2 (6/21–6/27): if a candidate passes stability, run product dogfood on dedicated pool (limited traffic) for 72h. If stable, schedule canary in staging for 7 days.

Meeting artifacts 
- Logs and plots: /shared/experiments/evals/2027-06-14/ (temporary staging bucket)
- Jira: RINF-2931 (6-bit onboarding tetrapack), EVAL-1123, EVAL-1140
- Slack thread: #applied-ml-evals thread starting 2027-06-14 "triage: 6-bit noise on model B"

Notes to self (informal)
- If attention logging produces too much data, sample 1 in 100 cold-start traces and compress with token-diff heuristic.
- Remember to call out how caching policy (prefix vs sliding) interacts with quant-induced precision loss — significant angle for the research note.

End of capture. We'll iterate this doc after owners push their artifacts; next sync scheduled Thurs 2027-06-17 (15m standup focused on experiment barometers).
